description: Use this when a developer names two to four sports odds or sports data API providers and wants them compared, for example "The-Odds-API vs OddsPapi" or "SportsGamesOdds or SportsData.io for player props". Returns a side-by-side table of researched feature support (pregame, live, Bet365, Pinnacle, closing odds, futures, same game parlay, deeplinks, settlement, stats, schedules, WebSocket, MCP server, esports), pricing scale, free tier, sports mentioned in our reviews, the differences between them, and the SportsAPIs.dev review URL for each. Providers must be in the SportsAPIs.dev directory. Do not use this to compare betting odds or sportsbook prices for a game.

providers.description: Two to four provider names as developers write them, for example ["The-Odds-API", "OddsPapi", "SportsGamesOdds"].

name: compare_sports_apis

next_steps.description: Which tool to call for the likely follow-up questions.
